## 📦 Downloads

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | `Riven-Setup-x86_64.exe` (installer) or `riven-x86_64-windows.zip` (portable) |
| macOS 11+ (Apple silicon and Intel) | `Riven-macos.dmg` |
| Linux, any distribution | `Riven-x86_64.AppImage` / `Riven-aarch64.AppImage` |
| Debian, Ubuntu | `riven-amd64.deb` / `riven-arm64.deb` |
| Fedora, openSUSE | `riven-x86_64.rpm` / `riven-aarch64.rpm` |
| Arch | `riven-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` |
| NixOS | `nix run github:BX-Team/Riven/${TAG}` |
| Servers (no GUI) | `riven-cli-<arch>-<os>` archives |

The macOS app is not notarized: open it once with right-click → Open.
